searchText: MSRP $456,507. New 2026 Newmar Northern Star 3709 Bath & 1/2 model for sale at Motor Home Specialist Features Full-Wall Slide King Bed Carefree Awning Theater Seats Splendide Washer/Dryer Premier Air Mattress Drop Down Loft Exterior TV More About This RV You will be met with comfort when you travel in this triple slide out coach! The main living area includes a Jackknife sofa and booth dinette across from a Samsung LED TV on power lift so you can enjoy movie nights. A full kitchen is waiting for you to create delicious meals on the three burner cooktop or in the convection microwave. There is also an air fryer feature you are sure to enjoy plus a 10 cu. ft. Norcold refrigerator and a pantry to keep food stocked. You will love having your own master bedroom that includes a king bed slide out, dual shirt wardrobes and a dresser, plus a Samsung LED TV. The full rear bath is both spacious and accommodating with its 50' x 30' shower plus optional washer and dryer, and your guests can use the mid-coach half bath during the day! Step right up to the diesel pusher lifestyle with Newmar's most affordable Class A diesel coach, the Northern Star! You will be met with a luxurious interior that includes maple cabinet doors, polished solid-surface countertops, Villa Comfort Fit furniture, and MCD window shades to name a few comforts. The Full-Paint Masterpiece Finish is ultra sleek, and the diamond shield protection on the front cap will help against debris, bugs, and more. The driver is sure to appreciate the V-Ride drive axle suspension, along with the anti-lock braking system and Mobileye lane tracking and lane departure warning system for added safety. Each model also includes a Samsung LED TV in the living room and bedroom, a 10' Sony dash radio, a Bose soundbar sound system, and more entertainment features to ensure you'll never go bored on rainy days!
